title: Offset blocks
headline:
Choose your first
AI project.
description: The same offset blue composition, with consistent curved joins and a very fine texture confined to the lit block.
changes: Added fine grain inside the lit cyan block.
Kept the blue field, lime inset, and headline crisp.
patternRule: Build the offset fragments from generous circular joins, using a 128-pixel large radius and smaller related radii. Preserve the quiet field and asymmetric crop.
gradientRule: The blue background remains flat. Directional cyan light and low-opacity fine grain belong only to one filled block; the front face uses a tonal-blue transition.

title: Cutout join
headline:
Connect your
company’s knowledge.
description: The same blue cutout and forest field, with a broad light transition replacing the visible diagonal stripe.
changes: Removed the hard diagonal highlight layer.
Spread the light smoothly across the blue cutout.
Preserved the open forest field and lime headline.
patternRule: Use one oversized asymmetric cutout with a broad step and a generous notch. Let the negative space carry the headline and retain the original crop.
gradientRule: A broad horizontal blue-to-cyan transition stays inside the left cutout. The forest field remains completely flat; no grain or corner glow.

title: Layered panels
sampleTitle: Build systems your team can trust
description: The same overlapping panels, with a quieter surface and cleaner separation between the layers.
changes: Cleaner blue layers with a faint edge highlight.
patternRule: Three empty rounded surfaces with the same 90px corner radius and stepped overlaps. Keep the structure abstract, with no interface controls.
gradientRule: A pale flat field surrounds translucent-looking blue layers. Each layer carries its own restrained directional light.
tags: Build systems your team can trust

title: Interwoven bands
description: The same white composition and interwoven bands, with more consistent round bends and a clean cropped edge. The original headline position and flat palette are retained.
changes: Standardized the three bends to the same radius.
Preserved clean, even white gaps at crossings.
Removed the narrow forest sliver at the right edge.
patternRule: Three broad flat bands use 100 px rounded bends and consistent 14 px negative-space gaps. Keep the over-under order clear and crop hidden ends cleanly.
gradientRule: No gradient or grain. Pure flat colors and an uninterrupted white field.

title: Stepped ribbons
sampleTitle: Turn repeated work into a system
description: The same stepped ribbons on a dominant lime field, with a clean mint layer replacing olive. Rounded joins are consistent, and the horizontal bottom wash is quieter.
changes: Replaced the olive layer with a cleaner cool mint.
Normalized rounded corners and concave joins.
Reduced the bottom wash intensity and height.
patternRule: Three broad filled ribbons retain their original stepped offsets. Use matching 70 px convex/concave joins and 24 px outer corners, with no icons or repeated full logos.
gradientRule: A very faint, full-width tonal wash is confined to the bottom 196 px. No corner glow, overall tint, or gradient behind the headline.
tags: Turn repeated work into a system

title: Soft imprint
sampleTitle: Give your team a clear starting point
description: The same soft symbol impression, with more controlled diffusion and extra room around the headline.
changes: A clearer upper edge fades into softer light.
Moved the headline left and slightly upward.
Kept the blue field and typography unchanged.
patternRule: Use the exact mark as one enlarged, softly cropped impression. Keep a minimum128px text inset and adjust the title block before reducing its size.
gradientRule: The upper edge has more definition while the lower impression diffuses into blue. The title area remains flat.
tags: Give your team a clear starting point
